# Tenkiller HMS precipitation catalog

These exact DSS pathnames were read from the official HEC-HMS4.13 `tenk`
example after computing `Jan 96 storm` through hms-commander. Element85 has
PRECIP-INC alongside losses, excess, cumulative totals and spatial standard
deviation. Catalog order is not a physical-quantity selector.

Source: installed HEC-HMS4.13 samples.zip, tenk example. This small text fixture
records catalog metadata only; it contains no generated DSS/model outputs.
